Thanks, Jasmine — this plan looks good. A couple follow-ups from our InfoSec lead: 

> On Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:45:00 -0700 jasmine_liu@redwood.com wrote:
> > Notes on redaction: keep production usernames redacted to alias form (user:XXXXX) and time-series logs should be truncated to excerpts. Full unredacted logs require a signed NDA/amendment — we should avoid that unless they explicitly request forensic-level artifacts.

1) For logging excerpts: can you include a short explanation of what the excerpt shows (one paragraph) and the total retention window of the full logs (days)?
2) For key management: we would like evidence of the last three rotation events for the primary KMS key (metadata only is fine — timestamps and key IDs OK), and a high-level statement of separation of duties for key admin access. If you cannot provide rotation metadata we can accept your documented KMS rotation policy.
3) For change management: if any of the artifacts are pull requests or ticket references, please include immutable identifiers (Jira ID or commit SHA) so our auditors can verify traceability.

We can do the walkthrough on Tue 2027-03-09 at 09:30 PST. Please confirm and include the meeting invite. Also, if there are any anticipated redaction or legal approvals needed beyond what you noted, flag them now.

Best,
Priya Singh
Vendor Assurance Lead
